takeaway: Plain backdrop, white cut-out or a bare room with controlled light; the garment fills the frame, often a full-length turn plus close-ups of boning and lacing. 115 ads (83 Bupbes, then Maël, Malimarea, RUE de RUE and JC de JC), 25 still running; RUE de RUE’s black corset set in a white room has run 356 days.

Looks self-made: mirror selfies, try-ons presented to camera in a showroom or bedroom, handheld unboxing, snapshots at dinner. 44 ads (mostly JC de JC and JUBIN STUDIO, mostly video), 41 still running; JUBIN’s 18 s try-on in an arched room has run 418 days.

A styled, magazine-like shoot: concept sets and props, theatrical light, glam sets in hotel rooms, villas and balconies, or dramatic places such as rivers, sea rocks and fields. 40 ads (30 IAM COCO, then Maël and Bupbes), 36 still running, most started in October; IAM COCO’s “Siren Call” set on a hotel balcony at sunset has run 172 days and Maël’s Cruise ’26 sea set 170.

A photographer in a real place with natural light and natural poses, no concept: villa rooms, doorways, staircases, terraces. 18 ads (mostly JC de JC and Cherie), 13 still running; Cherie’s “A Study in Lace” has run 165 days.

A designed card or collage led by text or annotations instead of a shoot. 3 ads; JUBIN STUDIO’s annotated corset cards have run 489 days, the longest ad in the file; the other two are other businesses naming the brand.
